defect: Standalone readonly_probe could return a successful final summary after native logout, token expiry or principal change during the final read transport. The earlier Client.call fix does not cover this separate entry.
fix: Reuse one checked envelope helper before transport and after each response. The response-side validation envelope is discarded and never sent; invalid authentication or a changed principal prevents the result reaching the UI.
new_conditions: Principal switch during the final read returns no success summary.
Native logout during the final read returns no success summary.
Native token expiry during the final read returns no success summary.
Each new case transports only list_requests and read_crf, without retries or business actions.
limitations: Synthetic authentication state changes and offline native signing only; no Google authentication operation or real keys were used.
This is not a real sixty-minute boundary test, live session-revocation test or old-key rejection test.
No settings, ACL, deployment, business data or audit history changed. Live 165-row invariance was not remeasured.
Recovery APIs remain undeployed, durable observation infrastructure unresolved, independent review and formal QA outstanding.
continuation: Use this updated standalone read candidate for future approved review; do not treat the offline result as authorization to enable communication or deploy.
